steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Lara, you're a lovely one to your family, helping with work the second you're back.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: No, I'm just doing what I should. I'd love to take a good look around too.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Ah, it really does change once you study outside. Far better head on you than my little brother.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: What a wonderful girl you are. Shame.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Who knows if I'll ever find one as nice as you again after I move.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Wait, Sasa, you've been living fine here all this time, right? Why the move?

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: My dad, you know. Yesterday at the Tri-Clan Council, they announced the Saintess would lead the three, right?

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Now Dad's all fired up.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Oh... Uncle Zoer was always against Sir Enciodes's open door policy...

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Right? We all moved here from up north back then so my brother and I could get work.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: And here, Dad pretty much got used to it, over the years.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: And now they announce the resignation yesterday, and he's over the moons.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: At dinner last night, he was going on and on, mad at Sir Enciodes for everything he'd done these years, and I was fed up hearing it. I even had an argument with him.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: But you can't change his mind in the end. We might end up moving straight back to the Paleroches' territory.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: So what about your brother's job?

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Who knows? Once the resignation's through, it's up in the air if Turicum can still do business like before.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: I heard the Paleroches say. See, in the first place, it was the Saintess last Council who wanted Sir Enciodes handing the valleys and mines over.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: If she's going to govern Kjerag, Sir Enciodes probably isn't getting any favors.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: It's a good thing too, though.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: You might've missed it, being outside so long, but the three clans got along fine at first. It's just lately, they've fallen out more and more with each other.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: A lot of people were scared, after last Council, we'd get into a full-blown war.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Yeah, it's amazing how Sir Enciodes yielded on this. And he's putting power with the Saintess.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Yeah. Just, it should've happened long ago, if you ask me. I don't hate his open door policy, seeing as our family made a good living from it too.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: But sometimes it really does feel like the old people say, how Kjerag's not like Kjerag anymore.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: Him deciding to give way now and make less of a fuss, everyone approves of that.

steps.name: Neighbor
steps.text: It's just old grumps like your big brother against it.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: My brother...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Aurora's Sister
steps.text: Oh, you silly kid. Told you to relax once you got home, but you just had to work.

steps.name: Aurora's Sister
steps.text: (Softly) You and your ore-pathy thing. You might not feel bad about your health, but we still hurt over it.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: It's alright, Sis. A bit of work like this won't get in the way.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Um, where's Bro?

steps.name: Aurora's Sister
steps.text: He said he was heading to the factory just now, and went out all in a hurry. Said he wouldn't be back today, either.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The factory?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Is that the Captain?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Captain, is something up?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Vacation's over, Aurora.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The Doctor got nabbed at the station by the Paleroche family yesterday.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doctor went with them, voluntarily. You should get what I mean. Likely some sort of plan ticking under that hood.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I took a rough look at the map. Takes some time from the station to the Paleroches'.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The Doctor should've gotten there by now, and we ought to be on our way.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I'm using the pretext to head to yours now to check the situation, then I'll come out and converge with you.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I guess I'll go rendezvous with the Captain, then.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: I see. So you're the one from Rhodes Island.

options: You didn't pick me out on purpose.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: You're very unique, but I don't know why it is you're so unique.

options: Back at the market, what did you mean?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: It was no more than a word of advice.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: You see? Aren't you under the watch of a group of strangers, unfree to even stroll outside?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Before I answer your question, tell me first. For what reason did you come to Kjerag?

options: To help Cliffheart make up with her siblings.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: So in other words, you're Enciodes's friend?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Mending the three Silverashes' relations?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: You speak some hefty words.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Then your luck is tragic, being drawn into a mess like this without rhyme or reason.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Yet it's beyond me, believing someone who can be so carefree in these circumstances is truly here on a tourist's plan.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: I'm very curious—how outsiders like you regard this land of Kjerag.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Peaceful... yes, it's been peaceful here for over a thousand years by now.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: And peace of mind signifies stagnation.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Kjerag's people are too used to this status quo, to the point they don't care what happens outside, nor have any interest in it.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: It should be a good thing by all rights, but lately, I've felt... *sigh*...

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: In the end, their belief in Kjeragandr is the root of what condenses the people in this land together.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: But at times, I've felt the people are somewhat too dependent on belief.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Can you sympathize? You tell every worry you have to the divine, hoping they'll come to help solve things, and so you turn—

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Though, so clearly, you should use your own willpower to change circumstances, you just take divine will as an excuse to stagnate.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Though, so clearly, you till by your own hands to gain your harvest, you still thank the divine for their generosity after the fact.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Though, so clearly, making the choices, putting in the effort, should be for each person's own...

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: You're very forthcoming.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: But most people like you, outsiders... in modern terms, 'foreigners,' hold such a view.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: The people outside long since developed plenty to grant them idleness, or in other words, labor-saving technology.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: They're accustomed to a convenient life, while most Kjerag folk have never heard of such things.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Maybe the people of Kjerag really can forge diligence and courage out of a harder life, can learn of belief and virtue in an environment far from all the pleasures.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: But I also don't feel it should continue for eternity.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: The people of Kjerag broke ground on a haven between these snowy mounts, but can they preserve their homeland's solidity and stability forever on tradition alone?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: The way you see it, should Kjerag change?

options: I don't know this place well enough yet.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Ah, so you think so too?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Anyone with a sharp eye could tell, honestly, that the transformation Enciodes brought can't be stopped.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Who can so easily decline their own life becoming a little less heavy, a little more convenient?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: And here I thought you'd say, everything backwards here should be changed.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: I've heard countless people say things like yours already.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: And those people, by and large, are those born and raised in Kjerag.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: How cautious.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: But I don't mind the cautious at all.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: It's just a shame. You probably have little time left to learn how this present country manifests.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: I have a friend.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: This friend has been thinking, all this time, about how to finally change Kjerag for the better.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: However, she's thought for a long time, and can't come up with an answer.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: She's gradually realized that everyone thinks different to her, and their mindsets, no matter who they are, all disturb her.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: She wants to do something, but every time she wants to, there's always someone advising against her.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: And now, she finds, she's become slowly unable to stop what those people wish to do.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: And it's in this moment you've arrived.

options: You think this is a sort of omen?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Omen? Perhaps any port in a storm is a more fitting description.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: An invitee of Enciodes, come from outer lands. The spectrum and scent of you give me an otherly feeling, peculiar and novel—

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Tell me, stranger, what does your arrival portend?

options: Come to mention it, maybe you can do me a favor.

a.text:
Ensia,
I hope this letter finds you well. I hear you've come back to Kjerag. I'm very, very happy for that.
Though I can't descend the mountain to meet you, getting word that you were safe and healthy delighted me more than anything.

I also hear that the people helping to treat your Oripathy came to Kjerag with you. If I have the chance, I'd love to express my thanks to them.
For saving my sister, they deserve the blessings of Kjeragandr.

Remember to greet your neighbors, and tell them you're sound. Be early to bed and early to wake, and don't forget to pray twice to Kjeragandr every day. Also, you're not allowed to climb any mountains...

Alright, I think you're probably fed up of your sister going on, so I'll stop nagging you here.
May you enjoy your time back home, Ensia.

I'll pray before Kjeragandr for blessings upon you.
P.S. If you can write a letter back to me, that'll be all the better.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Come on, I only got her last letter not long ago. Seriously, it's like she hasn't written in forever. She's on my case like this every time.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Thank you, Kjarr. You're always the one handing me my sister's letters.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's alright. The Great Saintess can't descend at will, so I go out and about in her place, and bring back outside news to her. It's as she desires, too.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Sorry, though, I've got no room to write a letter back for now. I'm about to get ready for something else.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Based on the bag next to you... you're going to head outdoors?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Where are you going? To climb Jungfrau?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Come on, I forgot until you mentioned it! I still haven't conquered Jungfrau!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But where I'm going is to the valleys this time.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The valleys? Aren't they about to be handed over to the Vine-Bead Court? And there're so many factories there, too. What are you going to do?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The Doctor's gonna head there, which means I have someone to see. Oh, Kjarr, you have no idea who I'm talking about, do you?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Ah, I do believe I've heard tell. The guest taken away by the Paleroches?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mm-hm. My guest in the first place, concern for the Doctor's safety is really weighing on me.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You're such a good girl.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But take care. I hear things haven't been too calm there lately.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia, we can depart now.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Worry not. All responsibility will lie with me on this departure.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You're a huge help, Uncle.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's rare you ask me to help you with things. How would I ever refuse this?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Kjarr, I might be gone for a little long while. If you can, go back and tell my sister I'll reply to her after I'm done.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's quite alright, I can wait.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Aurora, I need info to make judgment calls, especially your views as a local. Tell me how you see the Doctor's current situation.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Gnosis was likely in a very sensitive position, given he was formerly in charge of the mines and valleys.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Sir Enciodes putting the Doctor in that same position now is bound to draw Arctosz's attention.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Tell me in detail about why the mines and valleys are such a sensitive area.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Hmm... it'd be more convenient if we had a map on hand.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Kjerag's topography isn't too complicated, and it's not very finely partitioned either.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Usually, us locals just call each area the mines, valleys, woodlands, lakes, mountains, creeks, and plains.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The creeks and plains, and most of the lakes, are the Paleroches' in the north.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The Browntails in the west are mainly the woodlands, and the minority of the lakes.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The Silverashes are mainly the mountains, valleys and mines. They have so little of the lakes, you can essentially ignore it.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: And the valleys and mines... actually, they represent nearly half of the Silverashes' territory already.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Between them, the mines have always been incredibly important land to the Silverashes, because practically all the ore used in Kjerag comes from there.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: While the valleys were only developed in recent years.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Originally, they were extremely poor land to work, and there weren't more than a few hamlets. People always considered it an area with no use.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But after Sir Enciodes founded Karlan Trade, he chose that land to use for siting factories.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The majority of Karlan Trade's manufacturing is built there, and it's extremely close to Mount Karlan, too.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: On top of that, I exchanged some info with Kjerag merchants before we left—but everyone who comes outside to do business is related to Karlan Trade in some way.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: A month ago, with the Great Saintess's backing, the Browntails and Paleroches requested and organized a team to investigate health and safety issues at the factories.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But the team met a surprise attack secretly ordered by Gnosis, who wouldn't play along at all. I don't know how that info came out, but everyone believes Gnosis was involved in it.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: That led to the Paleroches' head, Arctosz, getting inspiration from the Vine-Bead Court to send troops to station in the valleys, and it's because of the consequences of Gnosis's extreme actions that he was finally removed.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: At the meeting, the Doctor mentioned Enciodes's reason for making the invitation.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: We do help construct Oripathy-related facilities for Karlan Trade, but he never mentioned having the Doctor manage anything in his place before.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Which is to say, the Doctor's actively climbed onto the scales of this conspiracy. Very Doctor-like to do.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: That seems likely, but Karlan Trade and Rhodes Island have a perfectly fine relationship, and the Doctor would probably only accept because of that relationship.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: For now, I can't imagine the reason why Sir Enciodes would want to set up the Doctor...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: What do we do now? Contact Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The landship's headed for Victoria. We'd need the use of a local large-scale comms station, because our handheld equipment's got no way to get in touch.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: (Breathes a long sigh)

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Captain...?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I surveyed for a stretch. Guard force at the Doctor's present placement is low-strength.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The Paleroche residence should have about two hundred in guards, training and arms not up to outside army standard. We can break through on a surprise raid.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I've checked surrounding terrain too. Alternate plan is we infiltrate, but that needs setting up explosives in multiple locations beforehand.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Going in and pulling out both need manufactured explosions to draw attention. There're some points in the wall structure that'll let...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Wait! Captain!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I feel like... things aren't going to get to that point.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: No matter what happens, we need to ensure the Doctor's safety. That's our first priority.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: ...I agree with that, but...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: If we bring force against the house of Paleroche in the run-up to the Grand Ceremony, then I'm worried Rhodes Island will end up an enemy of Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: What will the Kjerag operators at Rhodes Island do?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I need to consider the worst-case scenario, and the least honorable way of solving things. The present outlook is pessimistic, and if I have to make a choice, you know I'll only choose the Doctor.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: We all hope things won't go that far, but you know as well as I that it doesn't depend on us, and I have a responsibility to the Doctor and Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I just can't shake the sense that... Sir Enciodes probably has his own plans.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The Doctor chose to play them at their own game, so some kind of clue must've been there long ago, and the Doctor's already prepped to deal with it...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I've never doubted the Doctor's abilities for a moment. I believe.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But I need to make my own preparations beforehand. The Doctor put me on standby, so there's a place for us in the plan.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: We need to get in touch with the Doctor first.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Aurora.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: You respect Enciodes a lot.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Yes... Without him, I would've never been able to leave Kjerag, and come into contact with the outside world.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Understandable.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But for the moment, I want you to forget that. Starting now, you treat him as a hypothetical enemy. Can you do that?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If you feel like you can't, you can head back right now. I won't blame you.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But at the same time, I'm an employee of Rhodes Island too.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Remember what you've just said.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: But... do we have to watch out for Cliffheart and the rest too?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I trust Cliffheart, but have no confidence in Ensia Silverash.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: For now. We figure how to meet up with the Doctor.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You're the Doctor's subordinates?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: ...(Slash)
In an instant, a hardened steel blade streaks through air, stopping just a hair's width from the woman's neck.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Wow, that's a rare way to use a sword here.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Well, there's no need to be this ferocious to an ordinary girl you've just met.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Pinning this position, and cracking a joke in this context? Does that make you an ordinary girl?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Put the blade down first! Your Rhodes Island Doctor sent me.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I was asked to bring you a message.
